label: DEVELOPMENT (seeds 22101-22103). Descriptive; not a test result. PROSPECTIVE STUDY under docs/commons_d2_protocol.md (Step D2). O, L and I-myopic are evaluator-only; OC is privileged (lagged true factor levels); W is descriptive (privileged reset timing).

oc.rule: OC's held-out first-encounter probe excess over L <= .010 at every position 5, 10, 20, 40 (mean over dev seeds x held-out combinations reaching that position) AND OC beats G V1-like (G - OC >= .005 on R-held and on R-min) in >= 2 of 3 seeds

core_parity.rule: |G context-average greedy regret at 4096 (dev seeds x 5 contexts) - D1b MB-count test context average (0.00957)| <= 0.003

fc_spawn_rule_note: The FC spawn rule used here is 'lrt'. Under the protocol's literal rule a one-code library's default IS that code, so no spawn can ever happen and FC is bit-identical to FC-K1 at the same code lr (verified in the smoke check); FC-K1 below therefore also reports literal FC at the selected code lr.

selection.rule: lowest development whole-stream excess S (seed mean); AM* = the tuned AM or AM-factored with the lower S

pathology.rule: FC fails if, in any development seed (per-seed reading, as Step C): active-code changes > 3 x true switches of the slot's factor in any slot; > 6 codes created in any slot (the library itself is capped at 6); or mean code-to-factor purity (mean over slots of the episode-weighted majority-level fraction) < .6

power_rule: 24 seeds iff, for C2 or C3, P(>= 10/12) < .8 and P(>= 20/24) >= .8 at the development effect size and SD

test_estimate.note: dev wall minutes were measured with 6 concurrent single-thread workers; the L pass is sequential per seed
